title: Batch/Cache Suggestor: Canary Evaluation Suite and Safe-Apply Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a focused canary evaluation suite and an automated safe-apply playbook for the Batch/Cache Suggestor (recommendation engine that proposes batching and prefix/KV cache config changes). The goal is to detect small but meaningful quality regressions introduced by cost-optimization suggestions before they reach production traffic. Deliverables: a reproducible evaluation harness that runs shadow traffic and stratified offline checks, a set of calibrated acceptance thresholds (semantic stability, intent-preservation, hallucination indicators), and an automated rollback trigger integrated with the rollout orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: Can run full canary suite on a suggested config within < 90 minutes for 1M tokens of synthetic+shadow traffic
Defined thresholds for semantic drift (cosine sim), response length drift, and hallucination rate; stored as named policies
Automated rollback fires when any critical metric breaches with sufficient stat significance (p < 0.01) and minimal sample size met
Human-review workflow created for borderline failures and documented in Confluence
Integrate canary verdicts with rollout controller to stop or pause applies and notify SRE/PM
rollout_plan: 1) Shadow apply for 24h: route 10% of live traffic to suggested config in shadow mode
2) Offline gated eval: run golden prompt anchors + stratified sample against baseline and suggestion
3) Statistical test phase: use bootstrap A/B for semantic similarity and discrete tests for hallucination
4) Partial apply: if all gates pass, apply to 5% traffic behind circuit breaker for 2h
5) Full apply: linear ramp to target capacity with continuous monitor and auto-rollback hooks
test_matrix: Golden anchors: 250 curated prompts across NLU/Instruction/Edge cases, with per-prompt expected invariants
Strata: short chat turns, long context completions, code-gen-like prompts, multi-turn stateful chats
Metrics: cosine similarity (SBERT), token-level perplexity delta, normalized edit distance for structured outputs, hallucination heuristics (entity hallucination rate)
Sample size calc: dynamic sample sizing module (§doc) to ensure 80% power for 2% effect size on semantic sim
Human audit: 1% sampled responses flagged for human review for every canary run; escalation rules defined
